title: Qualcomm's Q3 Earnings and Future Profit Forecasts
description: Qualcomm's Q3 earnings have surpassed revenue expectations despite a slowing smartphone market, but the company forecasts a weak quarterly profit and anticipates a drop in Apple revenue to accelerate.

sections.heading: Earnings and Revenue
paragraphs: According to Yahoo Finance, Qualcomm's Q3 earnings have topped revenue expectations. This comes amidst a backdrop of a slowing smartphone market.

sections.heading: Future Profit Forecast
paragraphs: Reuters reports that Qualcomm forecasts a weak quarterly profit and expects the revenue drop from Apple to accelerate.

sections.heading: Market Impact
paragraphs: Bloomberg.com indicates that Qualcomm's profit forecast has missed estimates, signaling potential woes in the phone market.

faq.q: What did Qualcomm's Q3 earnings show?
faq.a: Qualcomm's Q3 earnings topped revenue expectations, as reported by Yahoo Finance.

faq.q: What is Qualcomm's future profit forecast?
faq.a: Qualcomm forecasts a weak quarterly profit and an accelerated revenue drop from Apple, as stated by Reuters.

faq.q: How does the market view Qualcomm's profit forecast?
faq.a: Bloomberg.com suggests that Qualcomm's profit forecast missing estimates is a sign of potential issues in the phone market.
